about.source: Blizzard's client data tables, build 12.1.5.70783, as published by wago.tools; built by docs/reference/build_content.py on 2026-11-04
about.fields: journalInstanceID, name, mapID, instanceType (Map.InstanceType as stored), maxPlayers, expansionID, listedBecause (expansion, or mythic+ season: an older dungeon one of the expansion's Mythic+ seasons tracks; INFERENCE); encounters: journalEncounterID, dungeonEncounterID (INFERENCE: = ENCOUNTER_START's encounterID), uiMapID, abilities (Adventure Guide section spells), events (EncounterEvent spells, severity); challenge: mapChallengeModeID, timersSeconds (INFERENCE), trackedInSeasons, enemyForces (INFERENCE): every challenge tree linked to the dungeon (linkedBy: encounters = its boss criteria are on this map; name = its name), each with total, creatures (creatureID, count per kill, percent, name when the client lists it), notCreature; when several trees are listed (older dungeons have a '(More Trash)' one), the one the game uses is the one whose total C_ScenarioInfo.GetCriteriaInfo shows in game
about.note: Trash creatures' spells and an instance's full creature list are not in the client data; Dev Assist's /xuidev instance capture records them in game.
